picks.name: Karen y Los Remedios
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on ZZK Records. Latin electronic/cumbia territory connected to your Nicola Cruz and ZZK-adjacent picks.
picks.bio: "Bestiaria" (October 8, 2026, ZZK Records) is the sophomore album from Mexican "cumbia noir" group Karen y Los Remedios -- twelve tracks of ritualistic, myth-steeped cumbia drawing on figures like water nymphs and witches, following their 2023 debut "Silencio."
picks.why_listen: Dark, hypnotic cumbia rhythms with a theatrical, folkloric edge -- a striking change of texture for a set that wants to move away from house and techno without losing the groove.
